newsitem.title: GERMANY: Five jailed for child sex abuse in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Five jailed for child sex abuse in Germany.

text.p: A Frankfurt court on Tuesday found a 40-year-old mother and four acquaintances guilty of sexually abusing her children, finding that the mother had taken money to let the children be used for sex.

The court sentenced a 54-year-old man to nine years in jail for sexual offences including the rape of the woman's daughter, then 13, and gave the mother a six-year term. Three other defendants also received jail sentences.
The case comes at a time when Germans are agonising over widespread child abuse following the discovery of a paedophile ring in Belgium alleged to have been run by a convicted child rapist.

Two weeks ago a 27-year-old convicted German child molester admitted to kidnapping, sexually abusing and killing a seven-year-old on her way to school in Bavaria, sparking calls for tougher penalties for paedophiles.
